invalidating_evidence_summary: Adversarial literature review after the original literature freeze found Chiastocheta rotundiventris larvae developing on Trollius altaicus and Trollius asiaticus. Those taxa were in the predeclared replacement-host pool, so the assumed exclusive dependency on Trollius europaeus is not valid over the declared species scope and two controls are biologically invalid.
interpretation: This is a biology/control-admission failure before snapshot access, not an invariant violation and not a sampling result. CROT001 must not be rescued by deleting the conflicting hosts, narrowing the species scope after seeing the conflict, or selecting new controls.
